reset_landing.reason: the RTL lands it: rst_n drives one kept async-clear flop rp1 at the S face + 2 plain release flops (ELEM-GAPS/HBMN1 n2/n3, native audit of q1 rst_n capture 455.7 ps); kit landing would add 2 more reset edges

pin_regs.reason: cl2 rule (owner 19:50, 10-15): ctlw RTL registers every leaf pin (issuer cfg/desc pin flops, raw rr capture rr_c, flop-driven rq/c_*/r_*/l_d_o/q*/bsel/lane_en/eg_* outputs); ot_pin_regs would add a second edge per port

floorplan_note: HBM-XLP10: floorplan / pins / CTS copied from hgi_sm_xl2_ctlx_bl. HBM-B 10-17 ctlx: d4f binds ctlw with EGRESS_SPLIT 1, so xw_*/x_done/rwq/bq_d (5,121 of 10,920 pin bits) are open/undriven; ctlx drops them (5,799 pins). Faces follow the d4f neighbours: N rr/rq from the VM banks (vmb_<q>0..7 north of xl_<q>_ctl), E l_d_o to the two quantisers (xl_<q>_aqlo/aqhi east), W the x-store/BD/egress pair bundles, S the host F20 cfg/status + clocks. 388.8^2 (9 x 43.2): N 2,192 pins 5.6/um, E 2,055 5.3/um, W 1,224 3.1/um, S 337. Calendar SRAM SW corner beside its cfg pins and the clk_cal entry; clk entry S mid.
structural_change: HBM-XLP10 10-20 PIPELINED x-load (TOK.HDS.SMMV): NEW variant of the CLOSED hgi_sm_xl2_ctlx_bl (same floorplan, pins, CTS, RD_LAT budget vector; the closed cl2 ctlx views stand untouched). RTL ot_hgi_sm_xload_cl2xp_ctlx: the issue engine is free on the last issue edge (x_busy) instead of at x_done; per-wave bits (bdm, BD tpair-last, BF go marker + 3-b load id) ride md/L/C/tag (+5 b on the 57-stage md line, +1 b on the 13-stage tag line); per-load egress fields {bdf,la8,P,count,xb} in an 8 x 23 b context ring keyed by the load id (written at start, read at BF launch / BD engine load); x-store rows and the BD write/emit tpair counts run continuously; tc/em_off/em_wait counters removed (launch = 5-stage go pipe). Single load cycle-identical to cl2 on every connected port; compiler at(i+1) = at(i) + max(ISS, LAST+1-FIRST').
